en.text:
Increases movement speed by 15% while guarding with <void/>Unbreakable or <void/>Sentinel Shield.

Blocking damage with <void/>Sentinel Shield refunds Super Energy after it ends. Maximum of a 50% refund.

Damage Blocked with an active Overshield does not count towards the Super Energy Refund.

Blocking damage <void/>Unbreakable refunds <pve 15% /> <pvp [?%] /> Grenade energy after recieving <pve ? /> <pvp [?] /> damage. Blocking additional damage can refund up to <pve 60% /> <pvp [?%] /> Grenade energy.
